# Mountain pine: a leaning trunk with flat cloud-like needle pads (flattened icospheres).
# About 3.6 x 2 x 4 m, origin at the trunk's foot. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Bark --base-color 0.1451 0.1412 0.2745 --no-slot
material new Needles --base-color 0.0863 0.4314 0.4784 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.22 --depth 3.2 --location 0.3 0 1.5 --rotation 0 12 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cylinder --name Branch --vertices 5 --radius 0.13 --depth 1.6 --location 1.1 0 1.8 --rotation 0 62 0
apply --rotation
select Trunk Branch
active Trunk
join
material assign Bark
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pad0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.15 --location 0.0 0.0 3.0
scale 1.3 1.0 0.45
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pad1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.95 --location 0.9 0.2 2.35
scale 1.3 1.0 0.45
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pad2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.85 --location -0.7 -0.1 2.0
scale 1.3 1.0 0.45
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pad3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.75 --location 1.6 0.0 1.6
scale 1.3 1.0 0.45
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pad4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.7 --location 0.3 0.1 3.6
scale 1.3 1.0 0.45
apply --scale
select Pad0 Pad1 Pad2 Pad3 Pad4
active Pad0
join
rename Pad0 Needles
material assign Needles
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.08 --seed 6
mode object
select all
shade flat
export pine.glb
